what: a modelled thread on a shaft that isn't the thread's size: refused with the size to use, never a silent change of the shaft
method: Decision (#1018, #2853): a modelled thread never changes the size of the shaft it is on; one that isn't the thread's size is refused, naming the size to use. A fill-to-tap-drill or turn-down option would be opt-in, off by default (see #3060), and get its own case. The refusal's numbers, from ISO 68-1 (H = P sqrt3/2, basic depth 5H/8): M14: an external thread's major diameter is 14 mm; a 14.6 mm shaft is above it, so the thread would have to turn the shaft down. Expected message: "this 14.6 mm shaft is too thick for a modelled M14 thread; make the shaft 14 mm for M14".
refusal: this 14.6 mm shaft is too thick for a modelled M14 thread; make the shaft 14 mm for M14
